adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with case-sensitive comparisons: `guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` while `blacklistedGuestEmails` is explicitly lowercased (`map(...toLowerCase())`). Since `guest` is not normalized, an input like `Foo@x.com` can bypass both the existing-attendee check and the blacklist if stored/listed as lowercase. Additionally, there is no check excluding the organizer’s own email (`organizer.email` / `booking.userPrimaryEmail`) from `uniqueGuests`, so the organizer can be added as a guest if not already an attendee.
